title: Axon canonical-node connection
description: The app-private connection contract for a device joining one Axon deployment. The current canonical node may be a Mac; a future home server uses the same slot.

node_id.description: Stable identity of this canonical node. It survives URL changes and migration.

canonical_base_url.description: The address of the deployment's canonical Axon node. Runtime validation restricts it to an allowed HTTPS tailnet origin, or desktop loopback during development.
